messages:
jen: CI failing on publish step for canary image, looks like registry rejected a layer. Anyone seen this? -- build ID 2026-03-17-1942
ci-bot: Build 2026-03-17-1942: push -> FAILED
ci-bot: error: response from registry: 422 Unprocessable Entity: unsupported compression "zstd"
ryan: :eyes: zstd? who flipped compression on buildx
laura: I merged #7892 earlier that enabled parallel layer compression in buildkite, and added `--compress` to buildx, might be that
nate: Ok quick triage: registry we use (internal-harbor) doesn't support zstd layers yet. We can workaround by forcing gzip compression for now.
jen: How do we force gzip in the pipeline? patch snippet?
nate: Add this to the buildx command:
```
docker buildx build --compress --output=type=image,compression=gzip -t $REGISTRY/$IMAGE:$TAG .
```
or set the buildx flag explicitly in the buildkite step.
laura: simpler: set env var in pipeline and explicitly pass `--compression=gzip` to buildx. I'll prepare a one-line patch.
ryan: Can someone push a quick fix to the pipeline and rerun the canary? I'll be on standby
jen: @laura can you revert the `--compress` flag in the merge commit or gate it behind an env var? That buys us time
laura: reverting now, will open follow-up to add a feature flag. pushing patch in 5
registry-bot: note: registry upgrade to support zstd is tracked at https://ourjira/OPS-3421 (ETA next week)
infra-ops: fyi, long-term solution is to enable zstd on registry; raising priority
nate: For CI workaround, also add explicit `--platform linux/amd64` to avoid manifest list surprises while we have mixed builders
ryan: rerun started: https://ci/2026-03-17-1942/retry :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Retry build 2026-03-17-1942: push -> SUCCESS
jen: :tada: thanks all. follow-ups: OPS-3421, laura to add env gate, nate to document bake flags in dev docs
laura: noted, will file a PR for pipeline flag and update docs
jen: closing thread once PR merged, good job :shipit:
